payload.reason: The evidence indicates that a new set of error categories was designed to improve granularity and standardization in error type evaluation, which was not adequately addressed by previous tagsets.

claims.text: The new error categories allow for detailed evaluation at different levels of granularity, which was not possible with the Nicholls (2003) or CoNLL-2014 tagsets.
The ERRANT toolkit facilitates standardization of existing datasets and reduces annotator workload, addressing limitations in previous frameworks.
The flexibility of the new framework enables more detailed observations about system performance compared to previous tagsets.
